g.text: Drifter. I am being hounded by the devil. He annoys me to no end with those little fiends of his ! All in the your name ! He says you simply wish to apologize on bent knee.
I am being hounded by the devil. He annoys me to no end with those little fiends of his ! All in the your name ! He says you wish to discuss my helping you in getting Monsieur Loid upstairs ?
I am being hounded by the devil. He annoys me to no end with those little fiends of his ! All in the your name ! He says you wish to discuss my commitment to le Cardinal once more ?
I am so very sorry. I know I offended you. And I didn't mean to. It was the very last thing I wanted to do, trust me.
Je vais le tuer ! Je savais que ce démon était rempli de la pire merde qui soit ! Je vais renvoyer ses conscrits d'où ils viennent par la peau des fesses !
I will not linger for long, as he did much convincing already in your absence. And as the devil is wont to be, he made quite a good case for it.
I will not linger for long, as he did much convincing already in your absence. And as the devil is wont to be, he made quite a good case for it.
And I admit I am... growing quite weary of being trapped down here with sans recours.
But it was not his words, yet his cleverness you should thank. He sat me down with Monsieur Loid.
[Confess feelings.] Because I care about you deeply, Marie. I adore you.
Never mind. This was clearly a mistake.
So, I say, very well. I will assist you. You will have my help.
But Loid loves Albrecht. Doesn't he?
I knew I was going to put my foot in my mouth. And lo and behold, I did.
You are as bad as he is.
It was Loid's clarity of sight that allowed me to see through my own clouded lens. For Loid loves le Cardinal - his Albrecht - yet he sees him for all his flaws all the same.
Yes. He does. And yet can see him for all his flaws all the same. And it was that clarity of sight that allowed me to see through my own clouded lens.
I am so sorry I resorted to Roathe to get your attention, but I didn't know who else to turn to.
For what does it mean to love another, but to accept them for all the best and worst that they are, après tout ?
Oh, Drifter... my poor Drifter. You did not have to go to such lengths to find my forgiveness.
I would have given it to you had you but asked. You already have a place in my heart, you know ?
But I went through so much trouble...
Oui ! And if you wish to be together with me, than I would like this as well.
And that is your own fault, not mine ! But if you wish to be together with me, than I would like this as well.
Ah ! You have made me so happy !
Je vais te jeter directement dans le Néant.
